column1: # ppsm-services.tsv - what each listening socket IS, for the PPSM CLSA (backlog 6a.22).
# HAND-MAINTAINED, and the only hand-written input to ppsm.py. Everything else - what is
# listening, where, the firewall state - is measured every 15 minutes by `monitoring.sh facts`.
# Built 2026-09-19 from the listeners all eight machines actually reported, not from memory.
#   port      the port, or * for a service whose port is ephemeral (random at each start)
#   process   as ss reports it. THE KERNEL TRUNCATES NAMES TO 15 CHARACTERS - the libvirt
#             exporter is "prometheus-libv", the contracts server is "contracts-airga".
#   cal       the EXACT service name in the PPSM CAL at that port and protocol, or - when the
#             CAL has no entry (then it needs a local CLSA entry and AO approval)
#   purpose   one line, for the CLSA. Firewall justifications live in stig-tailor.sh ufw_rules();
#             this says what the service is, not why the port is open.
# A listener that matches no row is reported as UNIDENTIFIED - add a row, or remove the service.
